name: open-autoglm-alias
note: calibrated from a real run. The Open-AutoGLM function-call shape is NOT accepted: '<answer>do(action="Tap", element=[10, 20])</answer>' throws 'Model response did not contain valid action JSON.', and the element form '{"action":"Tap","element":[10,20]}' throws 'Action must include x/y coordinates.'. The alias surface the parser does accept is the action NAME: normalizeActionName lowercases and turns spaces/hyphens into underscores, so 'Tap' parses to tap (this fixture) and 'Long Press' to long_press with the default durationMs 800. The <answer> wrapper is kept because that is how AutoGLM-style models emit JSON.
